frames.provenance: Committed baseline after host deterministic replay; no model action
frames.code:
FUNCTION NORMALIZE_SCORE(X)
  IF (X < 0) THEN
    NORMALIZE_SCORE = 0
  ELSE
    NORMALIZE_SCORE = X
  END IF
  IF (X > 50) THEN
    NORMALIZE_SCORE = 50
  END IF
  NORMALIZE_SCORE = NORMALIZE_SCORE
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION IS_PASSING(X)
  IF (NORMALIZE_SCORE(X) >= 45) THEN
    IS_PASSING = 1
  ELSE
    IS_PASSING = 0
  END IF
  IS_PASSING = IS_PASSING
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION SCORE_CLASS(X)
  SCORE_CLASS = BASE_SCORE_CLASS(X)
  IF (IS_PASSING(X) = 1) THEN
    SCORE_CLASS = 2
  END IF
  IF (IS_AT_CAP(X) = 1) THEN
    SCORE_CLASS = 3
  END IF
  SCORE_CLASS = SCORE_CLASS
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION IS_AT_CAP(X)
  IF (NORMALIZE_SCORE(X) = 50) THEN
    IS_AT_CAP = 1
  ELSE
    IS_AT_CAP = 0
  END IF
  IS_AT_CAP = IS_AT_CAP
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION BASE_SCORE_CLASS(X)
  IF (NORMALIZE_SCORE(X) < 20) THEN
    BASE_SCORE_CLASS = 0
  ELSE
    BASE_SCORE_CLASS = 1
  END IF
  BASE_SCORE_CLASS = BASE_SCORE_CLASS
END FUNCTION
